body:
## What to build

Respect the effective dtplyr execution environment when inspecting typed Grouping selections or preparing a nest from a derived step. If a safe proxy cannot establish the source types, refuse before invoking arbitrary caller code.

On main `f158df41168bbf0b64bce01518fcff1bd88cb11f`, build an immutable dtplyr arithmetic mutation in a caller environment that overrides bracket dispatch. The override delegates to base and changes character column `g` to integer only when called on a zero-row input. Native collection invokes it with two rows and preserves character `g`. Typed inspection and both Nest verbs invoke the override on zero rows during preparation and omit `g` from the Grouping plan. Name-only inspection avoids the override. #1281 covered join arithmetic and its follow-up isolated the internal metadata head; this failure occurs in generated bracket evaluation for a derived query.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Typed inspection and both Nest verbs must retain the source Grouping dimension when it can be established safely or report the existing safe metadata refusal before invoking the caller binding.
- [ ] Retain name-only inspection, base-dispatch typed metadata, and explicit native collection behavior.
- [ ] Keep caller source values and ADR 0020's metadata execution boundary intact.

## Blocked by

None. This repair can start independently.
